description: This file defines the DigitalProduct entity class, representing a digital product within the application. It includes mappings to a database table, relationships to other entities, and basic getters and setters.

classes.name: DigitalProduct
classes.description: Entity class representing a digital product with properties for product linkage and file name.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the digital product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the digital product.

methods.name: getProductFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the file name associated with the digital product.

methods.name: setProductFileName
methods.description: Sets the file name for the digital product.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product entity with this digital product.
